comment: Single source of step names and argument shapes for the scenario validator (scenario_schema.gd) and the Node CLI (tools/automation/darkstar_auto.js). Types: string, int, number, bool, string_array, scalar (string/number/bool), array (of scalars). Comparator rule (coded in both validators): wait_until takes EXACTLY ONE of eq ne lt lte gt gte in; assert takes either exists:bool alone (with id) or id+prop+exactly one comparator. A step with dev:true is refused in the QA profile.

wait_route.comment: Pass when SceneRouter is on route and idle.

wait_until.comment: Poll an allow-listed property each frame until the single comparator holds.

assert.comment: Check once. Either exists:bool, or prop plus one comparator.

quit.comment: Finish the scenario as a pass.

screenshot.comment: target is arcade or window. Skipped (pass) when headless.

coin.comment: Attract only: peel the tape and insert a coin through real input.

activate.comment: Focus a control and press ui_accept.

autopilot.comment: Cabinet only: set the autopilot flag.

press.comment: Press an InputMap action (held until release or run end).

key.comment: Hold a keyboard key for frames (min 2).

mouse_move.comment: Move the mouse to window coordinates.

reset.comment: Clear all in-memory save slots, reset settings, release input, go to attract and wait for it (240 frames).

set_setting.comment: SettingsService only; key must be one of the four accessibility settings. Dev profile only (QA refuses it before frame 0).

snapshot.comment: Write <out>/snapshots/<name>.json: {frame, route, ui[], probe}. Name ^[a-z0-9_]+$; at most 50 per run.

wait_event.comment: Wait for count (default 1) occurrences of a probe event that fire after the step starts. Event ids are in caps.json probes.<route>.events.

perf_sample.comment: Append {frame, fps, process_ms, physics_ms, objects, nodes, orphan_nodes, static_mem_mb} to result.perf (cap 200).

set_stage.comment: Cabinet: start stage index (state goes to intro; wait for play). Dev only.

set_lives.comment: Cabinet: set lives 0..9 (emits lives_changed). Dev only.

teleport.comment: Cabinet: put the Vigil at (x, y) wrapped onto the torus, velocity zero. |x|,|y| <= 4000. Dev only.

spawn.comment: Cabinet: spawn kind acolyte|geode|shard at Vigil + (dx, dy), wrapped. |dx|,|dy| <= 4000. Dev only.

shoot_vigil.comment: Cabinet: fire one hostile censer shot from Vigil + (dx, dy) straight at the Vigil. (0,0) is rejected. Optional acolyte_id (int >= 0, or "last" = the Acolyte the latest spawn made) is the shot's shooter id; a dead or missing id is accepted (stages shooter gone). Omitted = no shooter. Dev only.

kill_all.comment: Cabinet: remove Acolytes, Grubs and hostile shots (not the ritual, not geodes). Dev only.

step_sim.comment: Cabinet: advance ArcadeWorld.step(1/60) N times (1..3600); needs paused_sim. Does not advance the CabinetGame state machine. Dev only.

wake_entity.comment: Cabinet: start the Awakening now (the entity is awake after ~4.2 s of sim time; wait for cabinet/world entity_awake). Fails on a Cold Sepulchre. Dev only.

place_entity.comment: Cabinet: put the awake Sepulchre entity at Vigil + (dx, dy), wrapped. |dx|,|dy| <= 4000. Fails unless the entity is awake. Dev only.

kill_acolyte.comment: Cabinet: kill exactly one live Acolyte (int id >= 0, or "last") through the game's own death path; shots are untouched. Fails when there is no such live Acolyte. Dev only.
